text: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with dextromethorphan may produce central excitement and mental confusion. Very high doses may produce respiratory depression. Overdosage with guaifenesin is unlikely to produce toxic effects since its toxicity is low. Treatment In severe cases of overdosage, treatment should be aimed at reducing further absorption of the drug. Gastric emptying (Syrup of Ipecac) and/or lavage is recommended as soon as possible after ingestion.
